title: MZ Enhancing the pause menu cursor size

posts.author: DumGamesEN
posts.body:
Don't know much to say but is there anyway to make the pause menu cursor a little bit bigger? I looked at this post
Changing the size of the pause sprite/text box arrow?
and tried searching the lines but I think the code in the js for RPG Maker MZ changed since this was a year ago. I'm using GabeMZ Message Plus plugin if that helps.

posts.author: SeaPhoenix
posts.body:
How much bigger do you want it to be? By default it can be up to 24x24 pixels due to how the windowskin components are drawn (see this blog post
https://www.rpgmakerweb.com/blog/what-makes-up-a-windowskin
, under the section Message Pause Cursor, for more details).
So one easy way to make the cursor bigger without any plugins is to draw a bigger cursor, up to 24x24 pixels for each frame, in the windowskin image. This image can be found in your project folder > img > system > window.png.

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body:
If you don't want to change it in the img file, you can try and put in the method that (+ maybe change position too):
this._pauseSignSprite.scale.set(2,2);
